No. You invite us as a user in your Klaviyo account with the access needed for the job. We never ask for your password, and you can remove us whenever you like.
Each package is a one-time job with a fixed price and delivery time. If you want us to look after your account every month, send a brief and we reply with a written quote in US dollars.
Do you write the emails and design the campaigns?

The Standard and Premium packages build and schedule campaigns from the copy and images you send. If you want the writing or the layout design done for you, add the Campaign writing extra or order Newsletter Design.
Do you send to people who did not agree to hear from you?

desc:
Klaviyo management for online stores means a careful person looks after your account so revenue does not leak. Ecom Swift LLC audits your lists, flows, forms and sender setup inside your own Klaviyo account, fixes what we can and builds campaigns from your copy.

## What does Klaviyo management include?

Klaviyo management is hands-on work in your Klaviyo account to keep it organized, accurate and productive. It covers reviewing how contacts are collected, checking that automated flows trigger correctly, tidying segments and lists, confirming the sender is set up properly and building campaigns that go out on schedule.

It is not a replacement for your brand voice or your decisions. You decide what to say and offer; we make sure the account does its job.

## Why accounts quietly lose revenue

Klaviyo accounts grow messy. A flow gets paused and forgotten. A signup form is hidden by a theme change. A segment counts the wrong people. A sender record expires. Each fault is small, but they add up, and none of them announces itself. You only see slower results and wonder why.

A regular check catches these problems early. Automated flows such as welcome, cart and post-purchase messages run every day without you, so one wrong filter can affect many customers. Cleaning inactive profiles also helps your sender reputation, which helps later messages reach people. Results depend on your products, traffic and offers, but a tidy account gives every message a fair chance.

## What a healthy Klaviyo account looks like

- Signup forms that appear on the right pages, work on phones and add people to the correct list.
- Flows for welcome, cart recovery, browse, post-purchase and win-back, each with correct triggers and filters.
- Segments that mean what their names say, such as engaged subscribers and repeat buyers.
- Suppression of people who unsubscribed or bounced.
- A sending domain with authentication records in place.
- Campaign templates that match your brand and read well on phones.
- Product feeds and dynamic blocks showing the right items and images.
- Clear naming for flows, segments and campaigns, so any teammate can find things.
- A place to track changes, so you know what was altered and why.
- Reports that you can read without a specialist.

## How we work in your account

We begin with a review of lists, flows, forms and sender setup, then rank the findings by value. You see the ranked list before any change, and the Basic package includes up to two quick fixes plus a one-page summary of what we found.

Standard adds more fixes to flows, segments or forms, a sender domain and authentication check, one campaign built and scheduled from your copy and images, and a short results snapshot. Premium includes more fixes and campaigns, a clean-up of bounced and inactive profiles, a thirty-day action plan and thirty days of questions. Optional add-ons include another campaign, a flow review and campaign writing. This is a fixed package, not a monthly retainer.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Keep one person responsible for approvals.
- Send campaigns to engaged groups before the full list.
- Review flows after any store or theme change.
- Name flows and segments clearly.
- Keep unsubscribes and suppressions respected at all times.

**Avoid:**
- Mailing people who did not agree to hear from you.
- Editing a live flow without a copy as backup.
- Sending every campaign to the whole list.
- Leaving paused flows untouched for months.
- Sharing your password instead of using a team seat.

## Who it suits

A store owner who set up Klaviyo once and has not looked since will get a fresh pair of eyes. A busy team without an email specialist can hand over fixes and scheduling. A brand preparing for a big sale can have the account checked before volume rises.

## What we need from you

Tell us which store platform you use and send your goals, copy and images for any campaigns. We never need your password. You add us as a user in your Klaviyo account with a role that fits the work, and you can remove access whenever you like. You remain the owner of the account.
